batch.description: HSTU B Unit (shift 1) MCQ question bank, academic session 2024-2025, transcribed 2026-10-31 from the publicly readable first page of each Satt Academy subject section (Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Mathematics 15 of 25, English 15 of 25; page 2 of each subject section is login-gated on Satt Academy and was not fetched or bypassed). All 60 publicly readable cards are included. EXTRACTION NOTE: public window = Physics 15 of 25, Chemistry 15 of 25, Mathematics 15 of 25, English 15 of 25 = 60 of the stated 100 questions; the remaining questions are behind Satt's login gate and are NOT in this pack. Answers are Satt Academy's own marked answers (reading-mode correct marker cross-checked against each card's test-mode answer field; the two agreed on every card that carries a key). Content is single-source (Satt Academy) and is not cross-source verified; both verification statuses are therefore 'unverified'. Keyless cards (Satt publishes no key for them): Physics #14 (Satt qid 545315); Chemistry #8 (Satt qid 545336); Mathematics #7 (Satt qid 545360); Mathematics #9 (Satt qid 545362); English #5 (Satt qid 545377). Bengali numerals in the source were converted to Western digits and MathML formulas linearised (fractions as a/b, powers as ^) per project convention; original wording and option order preserved. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: HTML question bank at https://sattacademy.com/হাজী-মোহাম্মদ-দানেশ-বিজ্ঞান-ও-প্রযুক্তি-বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়-b-ইউনিট-১ম-শিফট-শিক্ষাবর্ষ-২০২৪-২০২৫/all/mcq-questions (Satt subcategory 6523), retrieved 2026-10-31; local copy sources/satt-hstu-coverage-2024-25-b-shift1.html (sha256 is of that 'all' page). Satt's exam name on the page: HSTU B Unit (১ম শিফট), শিক্ষাবর্ষ 2024-2025, exam date 06-05-2025. Per-subject first pages retrieved the same day via the subject links on that page are stored as satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-physics.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-chemistry.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-mathematics.html, satt-hstu-2024-25-b-shift1-english.html under sources/. Page 2 of each subject section requires login on Satt Academy and was NOT fetched or bypassed, so only the first 15 of each subject's 25 questions are in this pack. Satt states 100 questions for this set (subject navigation: 25 per subject); the saved 'all' page's total_question attribute reads 100. No independent second source has been applied yet (independentSecondUrl empty), so content is unverified.
